name: bytestreams
description: ByteStreams marketing site — Smarter Workflows, Stronger Results

scripts.build:public: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && cp *.html public/ && cp -r assets dist js public/ && test -f public/portal.html && test -f public/admin.html && (find public/dist -name '*.map' -delete || true)
scripts.build: npm run sass && npm run build:public && npm run blog:build
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.toml --port 8787

author: ByteStreams
